knowledgeAnswers.rationale: SP 02 (Version 3, 26 September 2023), layout section: the swimming pool area is a separate area enclosed by a barrier; enclosing the whole property does not comply.

SP 02 (Version 3, 26 September 2023): plants that could help a child climb are not permitted within the non-climbable zones; SP 02 places barbecues outside the pool area. The lesson also keeps trees and other climbable objects clear of the barrier.
SP 02 (Version 3, 26 September 2023), above-ground pool section: the pool wall must be at least 1.2 m above finished ground level and non-climbable.

practicalCriteria: On a supplied site plan, identifies the enclosed pool zone and marks any direct door or habitable room that opens onto it.
Measures a supplied above-ground pool wall's height above finished ground level, and states whether it reaches 1.2 m and is non-climbable.
Identifies a supplied climbable object that sits near the barrier and records the correction.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Assessor observation of the site check
stopWorkCriteria: Direct opening from a building onto the pool zone: report and do not accept the layout.
Climbable object against the barrier at inspection: report and keep the pool closed to small children until it is moved.
Above-ground pool wall below 1.2 m above finished ground level, or climbable: report before use.
